check_ipu_availability: check if IPU hardware is available by calling is_ipu_available and returning a boolean
check_mlu_availability: check if MLU devices are available by calling is_mlu_available and returning a boolean
check_mps_availability: check if MPS devices exist for Mac M1 chips by calling is_mps_available
check_npu_availability: check if NPU devices exist by calling is_npu_available and returning a boolean
review_device_type_module: review the device_type module to understand all hardware availability checks for IPU, MLU, MPS, and NPU
